title: Still need to buy the mat for cookie dough.
text: Still need to buy the mat for cookie dough.. With the holes, you still need the mat, as the cookie dough will melt through as it bakes.  Otherwise, a nice thin sheet that can be used for other baking like hot cross buns, which has a denser dough and will bake on this type of sheet.  With the holes, it does a good job as a cooling rack as well.

description: Designed to maximize the performance of Silpat bakeware, this nonstick tray is extensively perforated to promote even underside heating while supporting Silpat’s flexible pans and mats. The commercial-grade aluminum heats evenly, while elevated sides keep pans steady and allow the tray to be inverted for use as a cooling rack. Commercial-quality steel rack supports Silpat silicone baking pans and mats, and doubles as a cooling rack. Perforated surface promotes even heat distribution across the underside of Silpat pans. Premium nonstick finish ensures easy release and effortless cleanup. Developed for French patisseries, and the choice of professional chefs and pastry chefs. Dishwasher safe.
